who_subject: Adults aged 19–64 in the MAGI New Adult Group, if otherwise applicable. Individual age, household MAGI, coverage and exclusion status have not been supplied. Work rule effective no sooner than January 1, 2027.
who_not_subject: Pregnant/postpartum people where excluded under the rule
People in other Medicaid eligibility pathways such as aged/blind/disabled
People entitled to or enrolled in Medicare A/B
Qualifying parents or family caregivers of a child 13 or younger or a disabled person
People determined medically frail under applicable criteria
Qualifying American Indians/Alaska Natives and former foster youth
People in other statutory exclusion/exception categories; determine eligibility case by case

qualifying_activities.activity: Monthly income of at least $580 under MAGI-based household methods
qualifying_activities.detail: Enacted WIC §14005.69(e)(6) uses the individual MAGI-based household budget. Earned income is not the only source, but gross rents, deposits and Kalshi payouts are not automatically countable. Exact income and tax classification must be established; no personal pass is inferred.

qualifying_activities.activity: Six-month average for a qualifying seasonal worker
qualifying_activities.detail: WIC §14005.69(e)(7) permits a prior-six-month average of at least $580/month only when the individual is a seasonal worker under IRC §45R(d)(5)(B); variable trading results alone do not prove that status.
Paid employment, self-employment, gig work. Includes all jobs.
Enrolled at least half-time in educational or career/technical education program. Less than half-time can combine hours to reach 80.
Any mix of above totaling >=80 hrs/month, or income equivalent

how_verified: Counties should first use available reliable information; where data sources conflict and adversely affect eligibility, request confirmation before adverse action. If compliance cannot be verified, send notice and allow 30 calendar days for response; enrolled services continue during that period. Six-month renewal policy is effective January 1, 2027, with first affected dates expected March 1, 2027.
